Bancassurance and Bancatakaful SOP review2.2.8, pages 20 to 22

Staff licensing: keep our six hand-offs

Most of 2.2.8 is HR, L&D, the insurers, line managers and sales staff doing their own jobs. A Licensing and Certification SOP already exists, and this section even points to it.

Stays: what our team does

  • Forward the insurers’ consolidated agent listings to L&D Admin every month
  • Send branches the active MSIG GenLink ID listing
  • Collect licence evidence and staff movement updates from telemarketing OSPs, checked at their annual review
  • Arrange the yearly CPD trainings with the insurers and L&D
  • Give L&D the e-RFP enrolment list
  • Ask insurers to terminate agent codes for staff who miss CPD or RFP

Goes to the Licensing and Certification SOP

  • Licence table by job role (PCE, CEILLI, TBE)
  • CPD hours (30, 8 and 20) and the RFP rule
  • Call centre rules: team leader licence, 1 to 10 ratio, product training
  • HR’s staff movement listing to the insurers
  • Insurers ending agent codes within 2 working days
  • L&D uploading licence status and enrolling e-RFP
  • The Branch Manager or CSOM GenLink deletion form

Replace withOne pointer to the Investment and Insurance / Takaful Licensing and Certification SOP.

Check first. Make sure that SOP really has the licence table and CPD hours. If it doesn’t, those rules would end up nowhere.

Also fix. Pages 20 and 21 say telemarketing Project Managers and Team Leaders need licences. Page 22 says only Team Leaders do.

Bancassurance and Bancatakaful SOP reviewBefore we cut

Five things to confirm before we cut

The answers decide some cuts here, and in the sections still to come.

Scope

Does “own department” mean RWM Bancassurance only, or all of RWM? The SOP also relies on RWM Compliance, RWM Operational Risk, RWM Sales Supervisory, RWM Wealth Marketing and the HLISB PD Team. For now we’ve assumed RWM Bancassurance only.

Credit products

Does RWM Bancassurance manage credit life, fire, motor and Credit Shield Premier, or do the lending and cards teams? This decides several sections still to come.

Empanelment

Does RWM play any part in appointing or reviewing panel insurers? If not, 2.2.2 can go.

FD-i approval

FD promo codes need our HOD’s approval in 2.2.9, but FD-i codes only need the Head of PFS-i in 2.2.10. Is that intended?

Control areas

Run the fraud, complaints and RCSA cuts past RWM Compliance and ORM before finalising.

Small fixes spotted along the way

Places where the SOP says two different things, or has gone out of date.

Says two different things

  • PRAC is called a “Committee” in one place and a “Sub-Committee” in another.
  • “BA” means Banca Advisor in the glossary, but Business Automation in 2.2.10.
  • The licensing SOP has two different names in 2.1.2 and 2.2.8.
  • Telemarketing licences: Project Manager and Team Leader on pages 20 to 21, Team Leader only on page 22.
  • 1.2 mentions branches only, while 2.2.1 adds telemarketing and online.
  • 2.2.9 says “Deletion” with no trigger, 2.2.10 says “Deactivation” on promo expiry, and 2.2.10’s headings say “FD” instead of “FD-i”.

Out of date or unclear

  • The rules list in 2.1.1 is dated May 2025.
  • 2.2.3 item 3 reads in a circle: approved by PRAC, then presented at PRAC.
  • 2.2.3 item 6 still has the insurer passing IT a “CD” for sales illustrations.
  • 2.2.3 item 5 names GITI as responsible, but the steps involve BNSPD, CKM and Business Finance.
  • 2.2.8 names BNSPD as responsible, but no step mentions them.
  • 2.2.7(e) opens with “Below shall disclose clearly…”, and its PIDM statements need checking against PIDM’s current version.
